run_fit_normalizers_cli: run the fit_normalizers script with --config and --out-path to compute dataset mean and std
run_fit_norms_with_linref: run fit_norms with a linear reference file to compute element-wise normalized statistics
create_normalizers_from_config: create normalizers by loading a training dataset from config and fitting mean and std values
fit_normalizers_for_targets: fit normalizers for specified targets using batched dataset samples and optional override values
save_normalizers_checkpoint: save fitted normalizers to a checkpoint file at the specified output path
